name: m5_blue Cloud Agent
install: python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade platformio && if ! grep -Fq 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.profile"; then echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.profile"; fi && if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/pio" /usr/local/bin/pio && sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/platformio" /usr/local/bin/platformio; fi
